blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Six people, including an infant, died while 17 other passengers were injured after an Elf truck plunged into a ravine in Bontoc, Mountain Province, on Tuesday afternoon, Sept. 15. The truck, carrying 27 passengers, was traveling from Isabela to Bakun town in Benguet via Paracelis town in Mountain Province when it skidded off the road and plunged 50 to 100 meters. The Bontoc Emergency Operations Center (EOC) received a report about the crash at 12:40 p.m. Responders established by 5 p.m. that six passengers had died in the fall.
